title: Mother and Toddler in Park, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A crisp 1940s black-and-white outdoor snapshot featuring a smiling mother kneeling beside her toddler daughter in a sunny park. The young mother wears 1940s-style casual trousers and a button-down shirt with structured shoulders and rolled dark hair. The toddler wears a light-patterned dress, white shoes with socks, and holds a black stuffed toy animal. Bare spring trees and manicured lawn stretch across the background.
